description: This source file defines the AOS_QuotesController class, which extends the SugarController class to handle editing view logic for quotes within the SuiteCRM application. It contains the 'action_editview' method that populates quote beans with data fetched from related invoices, contracts, accounts, contacts, and opportunities based on request parameters.

classes.name: AOS_QuotesController
classes.description: Controller class for handling quote edit views, extending the core SugarController, and managing the population of quote data from related entities.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Handles the logic to prepare the quote edit view, populating fields based on related invoice, contract, account, contact, and opportunity data retrieved from the database.
